origin.basis: Veloflex was founded in 1981 in Italy (about page).

manufacturing.basis: Veloflex says its tires are handmade in its laboratory in Presezzo, Italy.

availability.note: Listed in Veloflex's own web store without a readable price on 2026-11-01; other regions not verified.

name: Corsa EVO TLR
positioning: Veloflex's handmade 320 TPI tubeless-ready road tire for racing and training, with an RKB belt.
protection: RKB belt and SPS sidewall protection
caveats: Veloflex gives suggested pressures, not maximums.
No price was readable on the official store.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other.

reports.summary: The best ride quality the owner has had from a tubeless tire, gripping well and as fast as other tubeless tires, but it drank sealant and needed a refill every month.

checks.note: An owner on the Corsa Race TLR test
